newsitem.title: USA: Vintage to buy Bolivian oil, gas interests.
newsitem.headline: Vintage to buy Bolivian oil, gas interests.

text.p: Vintage Petroleum Inc said it signed an agreement to buy certain oil and gas interests in Bolivia for about $31.1 million in cash.
It will acquire 100 percent of the common stock of Shamrock Ventures Boliviana Ltd from affiliates of Diamond Shamrock Inc and Austrofueguina SA.
The transaction, expected to close by December 31, represents an extension to Vintage's South American core operating area established in 1995 with acquisitions in Argentina.
Current net daily production is 14,500 MCF of gas and 230 barrels of condensate.
Vintage estimates that in addition to existing production, the properties have a strong potential to add reserves and production through exploration as well as exploitation.
Vintage is an independent energy company engaged in acquisition, exploitation, exploration and development of oil and gas properties.
